facts.text: The hotel is in the Kuningan business district, surrounded by corporate offices, embassies, shopping malls and residences.
facts.excerpt: Surrounded by multinational corporate offices, embassies, luxury shopping malls and stately residences, The Ritz-Carlton Jakarta, Mega Kuningan offers a prime location within the Kuningan business district.

facts.text: The hotel's design is inspired by the ancient spice trade.
facts.excerpt: Inspired by the ancient spice trade, this 5-star hotel in Jakarta welcomes guests to a luxury retreat

facts.text: Guests are welcomed on arrival with a glass of jamu, an ancient remedy of herbs and spices.
facts.excerpt: Mark your arrival at the hotel with a glass of jamu, an ancient remedy of herbs and spices

facts.text: All rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows.
facts.excerpt: One of Jakarta’s largest hotel accommodation with floor-to-ceiling windows in all rooms.

facts.text: The Grand Spa Villa has a private soaking tub and access to the pool, while the other accommodations offer city views.
facts.excerpt: Our Jakarta luxury accommodation offers city views, with the exception of The Grand Spa Villa, which provides a private soaking tub and access to the pool.

facts.text: The Ritz-Carlton Club Lounge overlooks the skyline of the Jakarta business district.
facts.excerpt: Overlooking the skyline of Jakarta business district from the 26th floor, The Ritz-Carlton Club Lounge elevates the luxury hotel experience

facts.text: The Club Lounge offers five culinary offerings: breakfast, light lunch, afternoon tea, evening cocktails, and cordials and chocolates.
facts.excerpt: 5 culinary offerings: breakfast, light lunch, afternoon tea, evening cocktails, cordials & chocolates

facts.text: At Asia Restaurant, chefs prepare Pan-Asian and Western dishes in an open kitchen.
facts.excerpt: At Asia, watch chefs bring Pan-Asian and Western flavors to life in an open kitchen

facts.text: Lobo has an indoor and outdoor setting where global cuisines are served.
facts.excerpt: Lobo offers a refined indoor and outdoor setting where global cuisines are thoughtfully crafted.

facts.text: Ozone is a sports bar with live game experiences and a Golfzon indoor golf simulator.
facts.excerpt: Ozone Bar is a vibrant sports bar featuring live game experiences, crafted beverages, curated bites, and the immersive Golfzon golf simulator

facts.text: Asia Restaurant's weekend brunch buffet features seafood, a prime meats selection and fine cheeses.
facts.excerpt: Embark every weekend on a culinary journey with our exquisite buffet, featuring a delectable array of seafood, our new prime meats selection, and a variety of fine cheeses.

facts.text: The spa sits amid tropical gardens and includes four spa villas with private outdoor soaking tubs.
facts.excerpt: Nestled amidst lush tropical gardens are nineteen luxurious treatment rooms, including Jakarta’s only four spa villas with private outdoor soaking tubs.

facts.text: Spa facilities include a steam room, sauna, cold plunge, soaking tub, and a private locker room with a lounge area.
facts.excerpt: Guests can enjoy complete Spa facilities from a steam room, sauna, cold plunge, soaking tub, and private locker room with lounge area.

facts.text: The hotel has a fitness center, a spa and an outdoor pool.
facts.excerpt: At leisure, get fit at the fully equipped 24 hours Fitness Center, rejuvenate at The Ritz-Carlton Spa, or simply laze about by the outdoor pool.

facts.text: In the Spice Trail experience, guests make their own jamu, an Indonesian herbal tonic, with the hotel's jamu-making experts and take home a keepsake bottle.
facts.excerpt: Guided by our jamu-making experts, you will create their own revitalizing elixir to enjoy poolside and take home a keepsake Jamu bottle.

facts.text: The Threads of Heritage experience takes guests to Jakarta's Textile Museum to learn about batik motifs and create their own piece.
facts.excerpt: Step into an immersive experience at Jakarta’s Textile Museum, where the timeless artistry of Batik, one of the nation’s most iconic textiles, comes to life.

facts.text: The Tea Trails of Puncak experience takes guests to the Gunung Mas Tea Plantation in the Puncak highlands.
facts.excerpt: Venture into the lush highlands of Puncak and immerse yourself in the tranquil beauty of Gunung Mas Tea Plantation.

facts.text: The Ritz Kids program offers a carnival-themed in-room camp for children.
facts.excerpt: This fun-filled edutainment program adds new colors throughout their stay by setting up special in-room camp.

facts.text: Pets are not allowed at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: No, pets are not allowed at The Ritz-Carlton Jakarta, Mega Kuningan.

facts.text: Club access requires an upgraded booking, and Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access to the Club.
facts.excerpt: Club access requires an upgraded booking at the Club. Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access to the Club.

facts.text: Spa guests must be at least 16 years of age.
facts.excerpt: Spa guests must be at least 16 years of age

facts.text: The hotel has an airport shuttle to Jakarta Soekarno-Hatta International Airport.
facts.excerpt: Yes, The Ritz-Carlton Jakarta, Mega Kuningan has an airport shuttle to Jakarta Soekarno-Hatta International Airport (CGK).

facts.text: Rooms have 12-foot ceilings and full-length windows looking out at the skyline.
facts.excerpt: Rooms have 12-foot ceilings and full-length windows looking out at the dazzling skyline.
